inlines.v: THROUGHOUT, preposition thruout'. [through and out.] Quite through; in every part; from one extremity to the other. This is the practice throughout Ireland. A general opinion prevails throughout England. throughout the whole course of his life, he avoided every species of vice. THROUGHOUT, adverb throut'. In every part. The cloth was of a piece throughout
